rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance relocation payments (Section 37.9C)
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation to each tenant, up to a per-unit maximum, plus an extra amount for elderly, disabled or minor-child households. Ellis Act evictions carry a separate, higher schedule. Amounts are set by the date the eviction notice is served and adjust each March 1.
rules.key_value: Owner move-in etc. (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27): $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child. Ellis Act (same period): $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.status_basis: Existing Rent Ordinance section; page publishes archived and current annual relocation amounts.

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-controlled tenancies terminated for the listed no-fault grounds.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 instead.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
